description_short: Build 4-, 8-, and 16-tile asphalt highways for T1/T2, T3, and massive T4 traffic, with ramps and automatic routing.
description_long: Highway Roads adds three smoothly planned asphalt road families: the save-compatible four-tile T1/T2 highway, an eight-tile T3 heavy road with one four-tile lane per direction, and a sixteen-tile T4 road with two four-tile lanes per direction. Fast vehicles statically prefer T4's inner passing lanes while slower vehicles prefer its outer driving lanes. Every family supports flowing curves, repeated S-bends, terrain ramps, Q/E elevation, concrete supports, automatic terrain access, native construction sites, width-scaled gravel and asphalt costs, 140% road speed, and 50% base maintenance. MultiLangLib supplies complete runtime text catalogs for every official game locale plus a neutral Portuguese fallback. Existing prototype IDs and geometry remain unchanged; T3 and T4 use new save-stable IDs. Standard-width T intersections, four-way intersections, and roundabouts remain available for the T1/T2 family. Controls: E raises and Q lowers the requested height, left-click places pivots, double-click builds, right-click cancels, and Shift-double-click continues from the endpoint. The mod can be added to existing saves, but should not be removed after highway pieces have been built.
